articles.title: Influx of migrants to Ceuta gives Spain diplomatic headache
articles.summary: The incident has sparked concern in Europe while Spain also faces a challenge in balancing its relations with neighbouring Morocco and Algeria.

articles.title: Russia's businesses under strain from Ukraine's attacks on Wildberries
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones have hit several retail warehouses belonging to Russia's biggest online retailer Wildberries in a matter of days.

articles.title: ‘Everyone's afraid to die’: Struggle to recruit soldiers in Ukraine turns violent
articles.summary: Aggression against recruitment officers has become increasingly threatening, police say.
